scripts.routes:check: set -eu; routes=$(cd ../.. && UV_NO_ENV_FILE=1 uv run python -c 'from project.redirect_manifest import RULES, cloudflare_route_plan; print(" ".join(f"--route {route}" for route in cloudflare_route_plan(RULES)))'); test -n "$routes"; wrangler deploy --dry-run --env="" $routes
scripts.config:check: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env="" && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env same-zone-canary && npm run routes:check
scripts.validate: npm run types:check && npm run typecheck && npm run config:check && npm run startup:check
